uncertainty: Nominal pointwise t7/t3 whole-library intervals, uncalibrated simultaneous coverage; particles are not independent samples
cross_condition_covariance: Shared ordered library vectors retain all pair/field/variant covariance; each matrix is covariance of the cell means
inference: Initial cohort attribution and cancellation of recorded endpoint transfer; no capture, resonance, current orbital occupation or converged physical ordering
output_provenance: The new genuine meter pins current derived products; embedded source maps and aggregate closure checked. Parent readers did not publish historical per-particle output hashes.
